subject.title: feat: add publisher follow graph API

question: Should ClawHub make publisher-follow relationships a supported public social-graph API now, including public follower/following discovery and durable retention/deletion semantics?
rationale: The implementation adds externally visible routes and persistent relationship data; code review cannot determine whether that discovery and privacy contract is the intended long-term product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor the scoped public graph
options.body: Accept the documented discovery-only boundary, then require a rebase, focused API compatibility review, and live runtime proof before merge.

options.title: Keep follows private
options.body: Retain only authenticated current-user follow state and remove public follower/following discovery endpoints until a public privacy model is approved.

options.title: Defer the social API
options.body: Pause this feature until the publisher-feed and timeline direction has an explicitly approved landing plan.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the scoped public graph
recommendation.body: Accept the documented discovery-only boundary, then require a rebase, focused API compatibility review, and live runtime proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The available adjacent review history connects this person to the publisher identity and public-visibility boundary shared by this PR.
